set_policy_module: set a mixed precision policy for a Haiku module class using jmp policy
get_policy_module: get the mixed precision policy currently set for a given Haiku module class
clear_policy_module: clear any mixed precision policy associated with a given Haiku module class
push_policy_context: use push_policy as a context manager to temporarily set a mixed precision policy on a class
current_policy_active: retrieve the currently active mixed precision policy in the current thread context
